§3§lPurpose and mechanism§r
Place supported GT singleblock machines in the Kinetic Processing Array controller GUI to run their recipes using electricity and superheated steam. The recipe voltage limit is the lower of the installed machine tier and the tier of the §19§r standard machine casings in the structure. Those casings must share a voltage tier and remain casings; glass must be at least that tier. Build the material casings, pipes, gearboxes and frames uniformly in steel, titanium or tungstensteel.

§3§lPreparation and operation§r
Steel / titanium / tungstensteel provide §12 / 2.5 / 3§r times speed and recipe-EU multipliers of §10.6 / 0.4 / 0.3§r. Superheated-steam consumption follows actual electricity use after parallelism and operating efficiency: §14 / 2 / 1 L/EU§r respectively, returning the same volume of ordinary steam. Prepare electricity, recipe inputs, steam and return-flow space together. Pressure steam inputs, ordinary or ME fluid inputs, and native fluid-based crafting buffers can supply steam. Ordinary, multi-amp and laser energy hatches are supported; hatches replace ordinary material casings. The GUI shows current recipe progress and item/fluid products. Read the current projection when rebuilding; tick this lesson after reading.
